## Landed · anchor closed by the seat

PR #34231 MERGED at 2026-11-16T03:35Z as `d69cf9744e` through the merge queue. Its body says `Part of #33581`, so the platform did not close this anchor, and the seat closes it in this stroke.

**The fix.** `AppContent.disabledPackageDeepLink-13052.test.tsx` now preloads the lazy `ObjectView` route (and `@objectstack/lint`) at module scope, so case (b) no longer pays the route's cold load inside its 1000 ms budget. Measured on the dev's run: `571cf9082a^` took 691 ms, `main` timed out at about 1012 ms three times out of three, and the preload brings it to 41–46 ms. No timeout was raised and no case was skipped. The ui/AGENTS.md lazy-boundary note records the rule.

**What waited on this.** The PRs this regression ejected or reddened (#34180, #34213, #34141) are synced onto the fixed `main` by the seat next.

State change: `pm:dispatched` removed, the assignee cleared and the anchor closed (completed) in this stroke.
